# javaabu/stencil

> Fluent form schemas for Laravel. Define a form once in PHP and render it with Blade (javaabu/forms v2) or Inertia React (@javaabu/forms, through the React renderer imported as @javaabu/stencil), with model binding, validation rules derived from the schema, saving to the model and its relationships, closure-evaluated props, conditions and live fields. Dhivehi and RTL built in.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/stencil/.

## Rules

- Build forms with `Form::make()->schema([...])`, or a class that extends `Javaabu\Stencil\Form` and returns its components from `definition()`. Use a class for forms you reuse and for any form with live fields.
- Bind the record with `->model($record)` (or a model class for create forms, or an array for settings and filters). Don't pass values to fields: they fill from old input, the record and `default()`.
- Don't write validation rules the schema already gives (`required()`, `email()`, `maxLength()`, options, `unique()`); use `$form->validate($request)` and `$form->save()`. Add other rules with `->rules([...])`.
- Use `visibleWhen()` / `hiddenWhen()` / `…WhenChecked()` for "show this when that field has a value"; they work in the browser and on the server. Use closures (`->visible(fn (Get $get) => …)`) for anything else, and `->live()` on the fields they read.
- Live fields need a form class and `Route::stencil()` in the app's routes. Never put secrets in what closures return: the live route returns it to the user.
- Closures get arguments by name (`$get`, `$set`, `$state`, `$old`, `$record`, `$model`, `$operation`, `$component`, `$form`) or by type (`Get`, `Set`, the model class, container classes).
- Render with `{{ $form }}` in Blade and `Inertia::render('Page', ['form' => $form])` + `<StencilForm schema={form} />` in React. Packages that support both call `Stencil::render($form)` (config `stencil.views`). Use `->embedded()` / `<StencilFields>` inside your own form.
- Names use dots or brackets (`address.city` = `address[city]`). Name `BelongsTo` selects by foreign key (`atoll_id`) and `BelongsToMany` selects by relationship (`tags`) with `->relationship()`.
- Add `->thaana()` to text fields that take Dhivehi. Pass every label, help text, heading and option through `__()`.
- For a new field type, run `php artisan make:stencil-field Name`: a Field class, a Blade view and a React component registered with `StencilProvider`.
- Test forms with `$form->assertable()` (or the `InteractsWithStencil` trait) rather than parsing HTML.
